history.encoding: game-read byte, most-significant bit first, binary floats

aim.encoding: 12-way one-hot per port: valid values 0..10 and unknown

shared_context.encoding: eight current human button bits in NES controller order, then ownership of horizontal, vertical, A, B

state: Only pre-action cartridge RAM. No stored AI proposal history; ordinary machine reset/restore restores these fields.
limits: Aim is game state, not a promised bullet trajectory for every weapon. Existing weapon fields are retained; no speculative cooldown field is added.
